notice: Noseboom processing is updated. Straight-flight legs are found by a moving-window stability test with new criteria (ground speed, segment duration, heading stability and rate, roll, altitude range, vertical speed), a Quality Check section is added, and a project now carries a 10 Hz navigation table so downloads at 1-10 Hz and changes to the criteria work from the .ccflux alone. SIF timestamps are corrected: an AirFloX GPS time is trusted only where the receiver reported a position, so FLOX and FULL are read as UTC. Reprocess Noseboom and SIF.
